result.title: CDBM: Complexity-Diversity Framework for Building Morphology Analysis
result.summary: We introduce Complexity-Diversity Building Metrics (CDBM), twelve interpretable descriptors for building massings represented as vertical extrusions. They measure how strongly geometric detail is expressed (complexity) and how unevenly it varies across one- and two-dimensional elements (diversity). Computed for 482,241,306 OpenStreetMap buildings and compared with 3D Building Metrics (3DBM) and the LION shape latent on task-specific samples, CDBM is tested on function, region, contextual relevance, real-generated discrimination, human preference and geometry-conditioned generation. With gradient boosting, CDBM best separates generated from mapped massings and best matches human preference; with logistic regression it matches 3DBM on realism. 3DBM leads on the other three tasks. As generation targets, the descriptors show that models struggle to produce strongly expressed and heterogeneous forms. CDBM complements existing indicators.

AI.brief_summary: 提出12个可解释的建筑体量描述子（复杂度与多样性），在约4.8亿个OpenStreetMap建筑上计算，并与3DBM及LION shape latent在函数、区域、真实性判别、人类偏好等任务上比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 属城市建筑形态度量与3D形状生成评价，虽提及shape latent，但未涉及VLM推理的内部状态、视觉证据筛选或计算分配，缺乏可供核查的LVR借鉴线索。
